title: Finite self-injective dimension of a regular local ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. In the derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the complex $A[0]$ is isomorphic to a bounded complex of injective $A$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Thus there exist integers $a\leq b$ and a complex $I^\bullet$ with injective terms, $I^j=0$ for $j\notin[a,b]$, and $A[0]\cong I^\bullet$ in $D(A)$.
